snippet.title: Scriver - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Scriver is a roguelike deckbuilder where you curate an art gallery to build powerful synergies and impress patrons and critics. Score points by playing words that complement your gallery and work your way to the final exhibition. 

The game features 6 unique starting decks, 6 challenge modes, 120+ hand-painted works of art with distinct abilities, 45 items to enhance your deck, and 25 exhibit rewards that provide powerful bonuses, all combining to make each run unique and infinitely replayable.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4023970/Scriver_A_Word_Game/
